title: Irritating interface and usability annoyances
summary: This topic clusters mostly undetermined mentions of irritating usability issues such as repeated QR scanning, manual and settings scrolling, inconsistent controls, automatic creep behavior, and a clicking sound, plus one positive mention of screen scrolling lines during a reboot.

positive.summary: The positive review mentions screen scrolling lines during what was described as a reboot without framing it as a problem.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe varied irritations including repeated QR code scanning, reliance on scrolling through digital menus or manuals, inconsistent track buttons, automatic creep behavior, and a clicking sound near the gearbox area.

limitations: Most examples are undetermined, so the sentiment and severity of the complaints cannot be resolved confidently.
The cluster mixes several unrelated issues across infotainment, documentation, controls, driving behavior, and vehicle sounds rather than one clearly coherent problem.
